_nguon: EN-ALL GĐ 6 — bản phủ tiếng Anh của lớp 'trả lời theo việc' (xu hướng hào, nghiêng, khuôn câu theo kiểu câu, vai, dụng thần theo việc, Thế–Ứng, điều cần gỡ, thế quẻ). Ban biên tập viết từ nghĩa bản Việt; câu sách Hán ('trich') giữ nguyên văn. Chờ người bản xứ duyệt.

tien_giu.nen: go step by step and keep to the principles you set

giu.y: the line text advises keeping your current position and not changing now
giu.vap: changing direction out of impatience when the matter needs to be kept steady
giu.nen: keep your present routine, do your part fully, and do not start anything new yet

hop_tac.nhan: you need people working with you
hop_tac.y: the line text speaks of helpers and companions — alone it is not enough
hop_tac.vap: carrying it all yourself, or trusting people you do not know well
hop_tac.nen: find the right people to talk it over and work with before deciding

cho.y: the line text says wait: conditions are not ripe
cho.vap: acting too early out of impatience, before the conditions are there
cho.nen: prepare what is missing, set a date to review, then decide

than_trong.y: the line text warns of a danger point; if you act, act with caution
than_trong.vap: being careless at exactly the point the line warns about
than_trong.nen: plan your way out first, and break the task into small trials

lui.nhan: better to stop or pull back
lui.y: the line text leans towards not acting, or withdrawing
lui.vap: forcing it through because you have already put in so much
lui.nen: stop here, keep what can still be kept, and look for another direction

ket.nhan: the matter has reached its end
ket.y: the line text stands at the extreme: the matter has come to its close, and dragging it on will spoil it
ket.vap: refusing to close something that has run out of steam
ket.nen: wrap it up neatly, learn from it, and save your energy for what comes next

mau.khong_quyet: The hexagram does not decide for you; it shows the state of things now so you can choose how to act.
mau.nguoi_kia_khong_doc: A hexagram can only shed light on the matter between you and that person; it cannot read anyone else's private thoughts.
mau.mot_mot: One hexagram, one matter: this reading is only for {viec}, not for anything else.
mau.hai_cach_khac: Two readings, two sides: the classic text speaks about doing it the right way, while the structure of the hexagram by month and day speaks about the state of the matter — when they do not point the same way, follow the more cautious one.

luc_hop.loi: The six lines of this hexagram pair up in harmony: things come together easily and last. If this is something you want to end, the opposite holds — it will drag on and be hard to break off.

luc_xung.loi: The six lines of this hexagram push against each other in pairs: things come apart and change direction easily. Good when you want to get out of something; anything you want to keep will need extra effort to hold.

xung_hoa_hop.ten: Six Clashes turning into Six Harmonies
xung_hoa_hop.loi: The hexagram moves from pushing apart to coming together: scattered at first, later it can be gathered up; what seemed lost can still be reconnected.

hop_hoa_xung.ten: Six Harmonies turning into Six Clashes
hop_hoa_xung.loi: The hexagram moves from harmony to pushing apart: it goes well at first, but later it drifts apart easily; to see it through, take good care of the later stage.

du_hon.loi: This hexagram belongs to the restless group: intentions change easily and it is hard to hold one direction for long. Settle on one direction before you act.

quy_hon.loi: This hexagram belongs to the group that returns to where it started: the matter tends to go round in circles and is slow to go far or expand.

chung.loi: This is only a secondary feature of the hexagram; the main thing is still the line that stands for your matter.
